def: A shape with four sides that are all the same length.
defEs: Una figura de cuatro lados que miden lo mismo.
alt: Illustration of Rhombus: A shape with four sides that are all the same length.

def: A shape with four sides. Opposite sides are parallel.
defEs: Una figura de cuatro lados. Los lados opuestos son paralelos.
alt: Illustration of Parallelogram: A shape with four sides. Opposite sides are parallel.

def: The side you pick to measure height from.
defEs: El lado que eliges para medir la altura.
alt: Illustration of Base: The side you pick to measure height from.

def: How tall it is, measured straight up from the base.
defEs: Qué tan alta es, medida en línea recta hacia arriba desde la base.
alt: Illustration of Height: How tall it is, measured straight up from the base.

def: Lines that meet at a square corner (90°).
defEs: Líneas que se cruzan en una esquina cuadrada (90°).
alt: Illustration of Perpendicular: Lines that meet at a square corner (90°).

def: A side that leans. It is not the straight-up height.
defEs: Un lado que se inclina. No es la altura en línea recta.
alt: Illustration of Slanted side: A side that leans. It is not the straight-up height.
